body:
Africa Private Equity News is pleased to share the latest update to our Dealmaker’s Log, which tracks African private equity/debt and venture capital transactions.

So far in November 2026, we have added 23 new transactions from firms including: Victory Park Capital, Adenia Partners, Saviu Ventures, Helios Investment Partners, First Circle Capital, BluePeak Private Capital, Enza Capital, Ninety One, Swedfund, Mediterrania Capital Partners, AfricInvest, British International Investment, AgDevCo Ventures, Knife Capital, and more!

Access the Dealmaker’s Log here (also accessible from the navigation menu)

p: Africa Private Equity News는 아프리카 사모펀드·사모대출 및 벤처캐피탈 거래를 추적하는 Dealmaker’s Log의 최신 업데이트를 공유하게 되어 기쁩니다.

2026년 11월 들어 현재까지 Victory Park Capital, Adenia Partners, Saviu Ventures, Helios Investment Partners, First Circle Capital, BluePeak Private Capital, Enza Capital, Ninety One, Swedfund, Mediterrania Capital Partners, AfricInvest, British International Investment, AgDevCo Ventures, Knife Capital 등 여러 운용사의 신규 거래 23건을 추가했습니다.
Dealmaker’s Log는 여기에서 확인할 수 있습니다(내비게이션 메뉴에서도 접근 가능).
